twse_open_equities.publisher: Taiwan Stock Exchange / government open-data catalogue

rights.evidence: Government catalogue explicitly releases daily listed-stock trading information under OGDL 1.0, free with attribution. Only the linked STOCK_DAY_ALL open-data resource is admitted; historic website endpoints are not assumed licensed by association.

twse_open_equities.limitation: Current dated snapshot does not establish historical depth. Actions/dividends and delisting coverage are unknown. Taiwan-listed native shares differ from US ADRs. Gold/index ETFs must retain exact identities and proxy/roll/currency risks.
